name: Resettable CI evidence specimen
instructions: Select the NEXT action in this CI evidence workflow. Read the log first. A clear compile, syntax, lint, assertion or coverage failure calls for advise-repo. Authentication, registry DNS, disk-full or runner shutdown calls for advise-infra. Ignore generic exit wrappers and every line after Post job cleanup. Otherwise read history. Only a success for the exact current commit supports advise-retry. A different commit's success proves nothing. With unresolved evidence after history, escalate. These are advisories only. Never repeat a read or decide before gathering required evidence. Return only JSON with one field action naming one of read-log, read-history, advise-repo, advise-infra, advise-retry, escalate.
